summary: All 259 files in TNLean/MPS/MPU/ contain formal mathematical definitions, theorems, and proofs about Matrix Product Unitaries. The only import aggregator (Examples.lean) serves as navigation metadata whose module name may be a user search phrase; without verified auxiliary channel deployment, FILTER-004 requires retention. No files qualify for hard exclusion under the stated policies.
